notes:
Saying when to do something now works, in the right order.

'make it vertical after trimming it to 10s' used to do only the reframe — the trim vanished without a word. It now does both, and does the trimming first, because that is what 'after' means. Same for 'once it is trimmed', and 'before' keeps the order you said it in.

'and' and 'then' always worked, which is why this one went unnoticed.
